podcast.title: Philadelphia Punk Pioneers (1974)
podcast.body: Pure Hell, originating from Philadelphia, were active in 1974, performing their distinctive punk style before the genre was formally recognized or named. "Philadelphia's Pure Hell. They were doing their punk thing in 1974 before there was a thing called punk."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Not Influenced by Bad Brains
podcast.body: The band's early formation in 1974 indicates they predated and were therefore not influenced by Bad Brains. "They weren't influenced on bad brains."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
